dataset_version.inference_model: deterministic cosine/template evidence with a precommitted abstention rule; no LLM participates in the numerical identification loop

generation_metadata.metric_schema: stage-aligned-v2; benefit UnknownID-baseline; scans baseline-UnknownID; unsuffixed fields are legacy stage-two aliases

ig_validation.note: Predicted values are acquisition scores; actual values are entropy reductions from revealing both real 30 and 40 eV spectra for evaluation only.

energy_stop_diagnostics.definitions: Signed entropy reductions. Energy tie: absolute 30/40 difference <= epsilon; ties count correct in selection accuracy. Material help: gains accepted-correct, or entropy reduction > epsilon without losing accepted-correct. Net entropy utility = reduction minus epsilon per scan; stop utility = 0. Regret compares stop/30/40. Conditional rates use explicitly named denominators. Entropy is relative-support uncertainty, not identity probability.

open_world.note: The true molecule is removed from the candidate library. A confident identification here is a false library match, not a correct open-world identification.

calibration.reason: Error model calibrated, dev IG rank correlation positive, and no accuracy loss versus the heuristic.
